descFull: 这是一款轻量的PC灵动岛，帮助你更好的专注工作，包含剪贴板历史、快捷翻译、Codex状态灯、媒体控制、每日待办，支持液态玻璃效果。This is a lightweight Dynamic Island for PC that helps you focus better on work. It includes clipboard history, quick translation, a Codex status light, media controls, and daily to-dos, and supports a liquid glass effect.
